claim: no window key collides with a DF global binding (the macro keys Ctrl+R/L/P/S, the FPS keys Alt+=/-) or a DFHack global keybinding
a validation run leaves DFHack's overlay settings as it found them (seasonal-wildlife.groups not left enabled)
every string the window or the console draws is ASCII (DF draws UTF-8 em dashes as three glyphs)
every tab of the window refreshes in under 100 ms on the alpha fort
every scheduled job runs in under 50 ms per pass on the alpha fort
with every present layer on, every active species on every layer has at least one season
after the season is applied, every inactive species is held: its entries at 0 on land, water and vermin, its raw frequency at 1 in the caverns
removing an active species' last season is refused (make it inactive instead)
activating an inactive species gives it exactly one season
cycling an active species' seasons never lands on 'no season'

habitat from the raws resolves the Q1 examples: sharks, sea serpent, giant cuttlefish, pond grabber aquatic; hippo, river otter, crab, horseshoe crab, cave crocodile, penguin semiaquatic; albatross, osprey, duck waterbird; eagle, kestrel flier; wolf, dingo land
role is independent of habitat: orca and giant orca predators (curated), eagle and kestrel predators (BONECARN), sperm whale predator, whale shark, albatross, hippo prey
three size bands by adult volume (D4): kestrel, wolf, dingo small; bull shark, lion medium; giraffe, hippo, elephant large
the model's reading of every creature raw matches the audit fixture (data/fixtures/species-model.tsv); the first run writes it

the diet test checks habitat: a lion takes no shark, an eagle no sea fish, a great white no deer; an osprey takes a sea fish (a herring: DF's sea fish that are units all outweigh an osprey), a lion a gazelle (DF has no zebra)
after the matrix no season holds more than half the active roster, and every active species has at least one season
after the matrix every season of every realm and habitat group that has a predator with edible prey holds such a pair
co-align adds at most one season per partner, from a snapshot, and its reported count equals the season cells added
Driver B draws a water group: placed together in water that suits the species (body and salinity), tracked as a drawn group with a leave countdown, the entry debited
every layer has groups at once and a ceiling (`limits`); `quota` is an alias that says it is retired
an entry the tool zeroes is remembered and given back in season; `stock KEY N` writes the species' stock exactly
`odds KEY N` writes the raw's frequency (never below 1) and the detail page shows the share of the layer; disable restores it
`size KEY N` stands the raw's cluster range at {N,N} for DF's draw and disable restores it
send off gives every gated land group a zero leave countdown and opens the gate (no fix/wildlife pile-up)
call a land species: the pool is open to it alone for the next wave; the ledger records the call
the magma sea's natural species are keyed deep:TOKEN, on the roster when the deep layer is on (D7)
every wild unit on the map has an origin: DF wave, tool-drawn, resident, born here, untracked or deep
hunting on writes DIVE_HUNTS_VERMIN on the active predatory and water birds and HUNTS_VERMIN on small land predators; off clears every flag it wrote
Alt+H opens a help page for the tab with the vocabulary
E on the Vermin tab opens a family to its species rows, each with active/inactive, seasons and stock
S U A W on the Seasons tab edit the selected species' seasons and the Roster shows the change
the window opens taller than 34 rows when the screen allows, with all nine tabs on one row
`status` lists biomes, layers, the limits line ('limits [mode]:' since v7.1), cavern line, on-the-map counts, the invasion field, and the embark subset
`now` applies the current season's roster once and reports the active count
`enable` / `disable` start and stop automatic rotation (registers/cancels the daily scheduler)
`classes` prints the seven ecology classes, natural 'managed' and the rest 'left to DF' (D8, v6.3), with counts, plus the unclassified review list
`class <TOKEN> natural|auto` records an override; any other class, or bad args, print usage (D8, v6.3)
`groups` prints resident-group status (max, gap, detached, coupling, cohesion, swept) and the ecology line
`groups on|off` enables/disables resident groups
`groups coupling on|off` (and the `piggyback` alias) sets migratory coupling
`groups pack N` sets the coupled predator wave size; 0 = raws
`groups ecology [on|off|now]` reads, sets, or runs the ecology write once
`groups livestock on|off` makes the fort's animals targets
`groups nudge TILES TICKS RADIUS` changes the three nudge distances
`groups cohesion on|off|herd N pack N flock N` sets cohesion and follow distances and reports groups led
`groups hold TOKEN DAYS` raises every member's leave countdown; `groups dismiss TOKEN` zeroes it and clears the leader

`limits` (the retired `quota` is an alias) prints the limits line and what is on the map; since v7.1 the line names the mode: 'limits [map-size formula per layer]' or 'limits [single fixed cap N on every layer]'
`quota cavern N` warns that the ceiling is enforced on FREQUENCY and brakes arrivals rather than culling

`water [on|off|now|countdown N]` controls the water job (v7.1 adds layer, spill, mix, pull, guard, survey/depth; target and cadence are retired); status names live/dormant with the reason, and since v7.1 a 'water layer ...; season spill ...' line

`water now` answers at once (the wet-edge verdict is cached at load): on a dormant layer with 'placed 0' and the reason; where the water layer is live (v7.1: it turns itself on wherever the map has water, CTRL's 226-tile pool included) with the draw it made
source: USAGE.md; v5.8.2; docs/v7.1/fixes.md section 4 (water layer auto, R45 ruling)

claim: `place TOKEN [n] [layer]` places wild animals headlessly and debits the entry
an unknown verb prints usage rather than a stack trace
bad arguments to water/quota/class/hold/place print a usage line and change nothing
the launcher help (`help seasonal-wildlife`) describes the tool
enable registers a daily repeat-util job; disable cancels it
applying the roster writes pool quantities: in-season allowed species stocked, out-of-season zeroed
applying a different season zeroes the species that season excludes
a species with no seasons is inactive and held at 0 by an apply (v6.3, R1; until v6.2.1 it was left unmanaged and kept its stock)
Force wave clears the current group and a new wave arrives within a few thousand ticks
resident groups tracks wildlife groups on the map (gated/resident rows with arrival day)
cohesion picks a leader per herd/pack/flock group and sets followers
the leader is the lowest-id member up to v6.9; from v7.0 a group member chosen by size (largest male: mech.v70.leader_male)
hold raises leave_countdown on every member to ≥ DAYS×1200 ticks
dismiss zeroes leave_countdown and clears the leader
the ecology write relates every LARGE_PREDATOR to every target in DF's reaction cache, slotting any unit DF has not (v5.9.7), and reports the pair count
the ecology job fires on its own every ecology.cadence ticks while enabled: 3,000 by default since v7.1 (R37), 1,500 before
with the nudge on (off by default since v7.1, R38), a predator >40 tiles from every target for 3,000 ticks is moved to within 6
place puts N live wild units on walkable tiles with a population ref, debits the entry by N, and they survive stepping
on a dry/inland fort the water layer is dormant and the status names WHICH test failed
`caverns [survey]` reports each cavern band on the map with its levels and its edge water (v5.9)
a cavern entry is placed in its own cavern: a subterranean tile inside the band of its depth, water for an aquatic caste (v5.9)
a water entry is placed only in outside water near the surface, never in a cavern lake (v5.9)
`cavern [on|off|now|cadence N|countdown N]` controls the cavern stocking pass; status reports the caverns against the quota (v5.9.6)
with `quota cavern N` and the caverns under it, one pass places the shortfall into cavern bands, floor or water by caste; at the quota a pass places nothing (v5.9.6)
`ledger [N] [kind] [layer]|clear` prints the tool's own writes, oldest first, stamped 'y<year> <Season> <day>' with kind and layer, and a 'shown of recorded' footer
every write the tool makes leaves one ledger line: placement, roster and switch edits, and the session's arrivals, holds, dismissals, ecology changes and cavern holds when they happen
the ledger keeps the newest 300 entries, its total keeps counting, and `clear` empties it
`vermin` lists the embark's vermin as families read from the raws (fish, flies, fliers, mammals, soil, colony, crawlers) with species count, allowed count, seasons, abundance and layers
`vermin <family> off|on` blocks and allows every species of the family; `seasons` and `abundance` write every member
`vermin defaults` seasons every vermin species by family and layer: land insects spring-autumn (summer-autumn on a cold embark), mammals, fish, caverns and water all year
Vermin tab: one row per family with n / allowed / season / abundance / layers, D applies the defaults and the status line says so

Overview tab, the page the window opens on: date and switches, what each layer holds now, groups against their count, in-season counts, the next boundary with arrivals and departures, the ledger's last lines

the Roster's why column shows who set a species' state and when (you, fill, matrix, co-align, vermin, defaults; compact since v5.10.8) and explains an untouched or locked species; the full reason is on the detail page
`i` on a Roster row opens the species detail over the window (what it is, body, embark, allowed and why, abundance, seasons, eats, eaten by, on the map, history); Esc closes it
speciesDetail(cfg, pool, e) assembles the facts for one animal: at least nine lines with species, allowed (and why), seasons, eats and eaten by
`pattern [land|cavern] <steady|burst|trickle|dawn|follow>` sets and shows the arrival pattern per layer; a bad name prints usage; `status` and the Live tab carry the line
burst: two or three releases 2.5 days apart, then a quiet gap of gap_max to twice gap_max days

trickle: draws sized 1-2 for as long as the pattern is on (a standing cluster write on every allowed, in-season land species, restored on change); a flock may run one over the raw, flier or not (E42, E42b: raven and emu trios under {2,1}, never four)
dawn: in the first week of a season only bird and vermin-class entries are open for the wave
follow: prey mass on the map at 3x predator mass opens only predators; no prey opens only prey
on a lake fort the water layer is live and `water now` places animals from stocked, in-season water entries
water target / cadence / countdown are stored and reported
quota land N overrides groups.max_concurrent as the effective ceiling
quota water N overrides the water target as the effective stocking level
quota cavern N holds managed cavern species at frequency 1 while over the ceiling; frequency is never written 0
QUOTA.cavernThrottle (the old entry-quantity ceiling) still prints a 'cavern ceiling' line — a second mechanism for the same setting, measured inert (T7)
disable (or quota cavern 0) restores every held cavern frequency
the layer counter separates land/water/cavern and reports the magma sea and underworld as a never-managed deep bucket
DF invasions are excluded from every count via a real unit field
a creature in a disabled class is locked: not eligible, shows an L tag, cannot be allowed
a class override can only bring a creature in as natural; asking for a special class is refused and changes nothing (D8, v6.3)
`overlay enable seasonal-wildlife.groups` registers a map overlay marking each tracked group g/r
a tracked non-flier that has not moved in 5,000 ticks is re-grounded; the status counts swept=N
Add-new writes a master row and a live entry so the species is in the pool with no reload
source: USAGE.md Adding a new species; v4.4

a full session of console and GUI use leaves the save byte-identical (config lives in persistent site data)
the roster is re-applied at each season boundary and held daily against refunds
when a prey group arrives, coupling closes the pool to its armed natural predators for up to two days
`gui/seasonal-wildlife` opens a resizable window titled 'Seasonal Wildlife' with nine tabs, the Panel second (v6.3)

Roster tab: header with biomes and per-category counts, filter row (Alt+S search), creature list with cat/size/biome/season/ab/ok/why columns, season keys S/U/A/W, matrix and co-align keys, targets row, fill keys, Ctrl action keys, status line

`irruption` shows the status (off by default); `irruption on` turns it on and the status names the threshold and the three pressures; `irruption off` turns it off

Alt+L on any tab cycles the layer (all → land → water → cavern) and the window's title names it with the reason when off or dormant; the Roster's rows follow it
overlayLinks() reports the related wild pairs the overlay would draw and how many share a level; the overlay seasonal-wildlife.groups is registered
Ledger tab: the recorded lines newest last, coloured by kind, with the kind and layer filters

Z on Ledger undoes the last edit: a species blocked on the Roster is allowed again and the Ledger gains an undo line
`undo` restores the state before the last edit and says what it undid; with nothing to undo it says so

Layers tab: a row per setting (layer, concurrent groups, gap, pattern, quota, coupling, ecology, nudge, pack) against land/water/cavern columns, the water line, a line per cavern found or hidden, the preset line
T on Layers cycles the selected layer's pattern (steady → burst → trickle → dawn → follow)
R on Layers re-applies the biome preset and the Ledger records a build line
`preset` applies the biome preset and prints the receipt (allowed, matrix seasons, co-aligned, vermin defaults)
Live tab: resident-group status, tracked groups, ecology line, wild-on-map by race, quota line, cavern line, biomass ratio
Seasons tab: four seasons side by side, one row per allowed creature under its trophic level, +/-/X/. marks
ESC closes the window
Ctrl-modified action keys reach their labels on the Roster; since v5.11.0 the filter box takes focus only on Alt+S and releases it on Enter/Esc, so plain letters are actions too
the Roster tab's status line shows each action's receipt ('Applied Spring live: N active.', 'Set N abundances to 60.', 'Auto rotation ON.')

N cycles the season filter
Enter allows/blocks the selected creature (ok column flips Y/-)

Ctrl+A applies the current season live and announces it
Ctrl+F clears the current wild group and forces a new wave
Ctrl+D opens the dry-run season table dialog
Ctrl+W prompts for the row's abundance and stores it
Ctrl+G prompts for an abundance for every filtered row

an animal person stands where its root animal stands: role and habitat the same (JAGUAR_MAN as JAGUAR, OTTER_MAN as RIVER OTTER, ALBATROSS_MAN as BIRD_ALBATROSS); since v7.1 its mass and size band are its OWN (GRAVITATE_BODY_SIZE: the mean of the root's and 70,000 cm3), so its predator/prey verdicts follow its own body, not the root's

a food-web predator is armed exactly when it is not BENIGN (LARGE_PREDATOR is not the switch); since v7.1 a raptor (RP guild, not a civ race) is armed whatever its raws say while hunters.raptors is on, and V7.apply clears its BENIGN

a pelagic giant's water-draw weight is its FREQUENCY scaled down by size, never below 0.1 of it; a small fish keeps its FREQUENCY

`curious TOKEN resident` clears the species' CURIOUS_BEAST* caste flags; `thief` restores them; a species that is no curious beast is refused

land groups at once default to floor(sqrt(embark tiles)) + 1 and `limits land groups N` sets a number instead -- since v7.1 (R7) the single fixed cap N on every layer, and `groups auto` the map-size formula again

the engine's guild for each natural species agrees with the ECO desk's guild table (data/eco-desk/v2/guilds/species2.tsv) for at least 95% of them; species whose guild a later ruling moved (R25 vermin-root animal people, R24 extinct fix) are set aside

claim: an in-season species whose stock reaches 0 is held at 0 by an apply, and an active out-of-season member of its group borrows the season, given back at the season change
a surface GOOD/EVIL mythic species is managed (natural) only when the embark region's own alignment matches it, gated by v7.aligned
a cavern-only GOOD/EVIL species is natural when v7.cave_aligned is on regardless of embark alignment (alignment only limits taming underground)
a FANCIFUL-only mythic species (no GOOD/EVIL) with no biome match is natural when v7.fanciful is on, never otherwise locked for that reason
the Vermin tab's rows never include a locked species (a family member whose ecology class is not enabled in cfg.classes)

a cohesive group's leader is the largest living adult male when v7.leader_male is on; v7.0 fell back to the largest adult, then the first member; since v7.1 (R32) no adult male means no leader (grp.unled); a living leader keeps the role across passes; off -> the first member
the water limit is quoted and applied per water body (ocean/lake/river/pool), not once for the whole water layer (v7.0: with v7.layer_groups on; v7.1: always, the switch retired)
each cavern depth is gated and reported on its own, not pooled with the others (v7.0: with v7.layer_groups on; v7.1: always, at R44's cavern cap)

every layer counts its own groups: v7.0 (layer_groups on) gave land, water and cavern floor(sqrt(embark tiles)) + 1; v7.1 gives land and every water body the formula and every cavern R44's fixed cap (5)
with v7.seasons_own on, a species' NO_<season> raw flags are cleared for every managed species (the roster no longer deflects a dealt season around them) and restored when v7 raws are restored

with v7.solo on, a solitary armed predator's raw gets AMBUSHPREDATOR, the solitary-package natural skills, and stealth-free gaits; v7.1 picks the solitary species by MODEL.cohesionOf (raw cluster max <= 1) through V7.H.profileOf
a hunting group whose live member count x predator mass is under v7.pack_floor (5%) of the target's mass writes no predator/prey relation
a hunting group whose pack-mass share reaches v7.pack_sneak (25%) of the target's mass gets SNEAK on its members: 10 in v7.0, hunters.skills.pack_bonus (10) since v7.1
with v7.scav_mapwide on, the scavenger pass is not limited to cfg.scavenge.radius -- it reaches anywhere on the map

with v7.fishers on, every token set true in v7.fisher_list gets CAN_SWIM_INNATE (v7.1: and CAN_SWIM; CAN_BREATHE_WATER too when v7.fish_breathe is on); v7.1's default list is the bears, who swim already, so the write is read on a non-swimmer put on the list for the probe
V7.restore() reverses every raw write V7.apply made (seasons, solitary package, fishers) and reports how many
V7.natural is false for a non-natural raw (forgotten beast/demon template, megabeast, titan, night creature) while v7.fb_safe is on, true for any raw when it is off
with v7.civ_hunt on, a cavern civ race of an armed guild (AL/AW/ML/MW/RP) is armed as a predator whatever its food-web role reads; off, it is not
a cavern civ race is only ever taken by a non-civ predator of guild AL or AW, never any other guild

each ecology pass, a PREDATOR_OR_PREY cell DF wrote between two managed-wild units this pass's web did not allow is cleared to NONE; a citizen, livestock, visitor or non-natural unit is never touched by the sweep
a freshly allocated enemy-status slot's row and column, and a departed unit's cleared slot, are written NONE (-1), never STRANGER (0)

v7.domestic defaults off; with it on, V7.isDomestic marks the fort's own tame animals and V7.takesDomestic allows only guild AL/ML or any cavern-layer predator to take them; with ecology.livestock and v7.domestic both off, ecoIsTarget refuses the fort's own livestock
v7.sponges defaults on; V7.isSponge is true only for a SPONGE unit, which WILD.onMap and ecoIsTarget both skip, so it never counts toward WILD.countByLayer, a group or a target

a unit of a packaged species already on the map gets the profile on its soul (nominal SNEAK and the natural floor at least the profile's level); V7.restore() reverts the rating and the floor
V7.H.readback() returns one row per packaged species and every row's castes all carry the profile's SNEAK (casteOk == castes)

two armed same-species non-solitary hunters within pack_radius and in no tracked group are a pack of 2 (V7.H.packSizes); a solitary species and two hunters farther apart give none; pack off gives none
with hunters.raptors on, V7.apply clears BENIGN on every caste of a raptor (RP) species (BIRD_EAGLE where the embark has it) and V7.restore() sets it back; ecoArmed(entry) is true
a raptor takes small prey only: V7.H.raptorTooBig(eagle, DEER mass) is true and (eagle, RABBIT mass) false

MODEL.cohesionOf reads the whole-list table: COUGAR solitary, WOLF pack, FISH_PIKE school or solitary and BIRD_RAVEN flock or solitary by their raws' cluster; `hunters cohesion WOLF herd` wins and `auto` clears it
MODEL.swimScavenger is true for SHARK_GREAT_WHITE, CROCODILE_SALTWATER, POND_GRABBER and SHARK_NURSE, false for FISH_LAMPREY_SEA and FISH_PIKE, and false for all with hunters.swim_scav off

near a river or lake, V7.H.bankPair finds a dry tile G (flow < 4) and a swimming-depth water tile W (flow >= 4) adjacent, where a bear on G reaches a fish in W: at the same level, or (DF's banks, a level above the water) G one level up beside the flooded ramp W joins it to
the caste NATURAL_SKILL write on a solitary hunter is read on a newly arrived unit: a unit placed while the v7 raws hold carries SNEAK at the profile's level on its soul with no unit write
`hunters cohesion WOLF herd` reaches the leaders: a WOLF group's label is herd at the herd follow distance, `auto` gives pack back; `hunters cohesion COUGAR solitary` leaves a cougar group unled
`hunters swimscav SHARK_NURSE off` makes SCAV.kind(SHARK_NURSE) false at once, without a reload (CACHE.scavKind cleared)
vermin foraging with a scavenger waiting on remains runs without an error and never sends the waiting scavenger foraging (VERMIN.forager reads CACHE.scav7)
after `roster build land`, `vermin edges edges` reads per-species rows from the build and V7.apply writes an SWV class into at least one consumer's GOBBLE_VERMIN_CLASS
`roster apex now water` places a pelagic apex only in the ocean, never on a lake-only map, and a placed apex group is led (or marked unled) at once
a config that never set the water layer turns it on where the map has water (a ledger line 'water layer on by default'), leaves it off on a dry map, and never overrides a layer the player set
a saved {layers={water=true}} loads water.layer_set true; {layers={water=false}} and a config with no layers load false; a saved layer_set wins

a water body with fewer than water.spill.min drawable in-season species borrows the season for active water species (assign gains the season, stock > 0); the season change and `water spill off` give every borrowed season back
a spaced raw id resolves from its underscore form and its #index (also with a layer prefix), an exact id is left alone, and `odds` prints the same line for the underscore and the quoted form
loading a second world in the same session leaves CACHE.depth holding only its caves and CACHE.raceIdx its race indices, shared by every script copy
`limits cavern ceiling 3` leaves groups.cavern_max mirroring groups.cavern_cap (QUOTA.set)
after a scavenging pass the status's last-pass line is that pass (age near 0), not a stale earlier one
a pass leaves the shared state in CACHE.scav7, and the console's status and a reqscript copy's SCAV.status show the same fallbacks
SCAV.is: SHARK_GREAT_WHITE, CROCODILE_SALTWATER, ALLIGATOR and ORCA scavenge, FISH_CARP and SHARK_WHALE do not; `scavenge swimmers off` takes every swim-kind scavenger out
`scavenge set hop_tiles 99` is refused (range 1-50) and changes nothing; `scavenge set hop_tiles 6` is saved, shown by `scavenge keys` and kept by the sanitiser on reload

a fresh remains cannot be found in its first pass with the default discovery medians (found after at least discover_min_h); with every discover_*_h, discover_min_h and the sigma at 0 it can be found at once
a finished remains is attributed: SCAV.stats().pairs['TOK>PREY'].n >= 1 and the ledger has 'scavenging: a PREY ... eaten -- TOK'
SCAV.naturalRemains is false for a non-natural race (demon, forgotten beast, megabeast...) and true for a natural one; no scavenger the pass walks is non-natural
`disable` cancels the scavenging and curious jobs (repeat-util holds neither)
`curious reform off|on|now`, `curious loot keep|drop` and `curious set stay_min 25000` each print the curious status with the change; an out-of-range value is refused and changes nothing

a curious thief whose countdown reaches 0 is reformed within one pass: its unit curious bits cleared, its countdown stay_min..stay_max, a ledger line 'reformed and stays'; disable puts the bits back and the countdown at 0
the Panel has the curiousreform switch; all off turns it off and its restore path reaches the reformed thieves

scav_ext's reach: v7.scav_ext on by default; a flier, an aquatic and an amphibious scavenger are told apart (SCAV.mover), a wet remains suits a swimmer and a dry one a land scavenger, and a wet remains is reached from 2 tiles and a level (the bank/water reach); the status carries the fallbacks counter
limits mode formula: land and every water body hold floor(sqrt(embark tiles)) + 1 groups at once, each cavern its universal cap of 5 (R44)
`limits fixed 2` gives every land and water key 2 and each cavern min(5, 2); `limits formula` puts the map-size formula back
a config saved with v7.layer_groups=false loads true, and `v7 layer_groups off` is refused with the retirement note
a v7.0 config migrates once: water ceiling 12 -> 0 (R45), an explicit land number (auto=false, 4) -> limits mode fixed 4, seasons_own forced on (R29), cavern_max 2 not carried (cap 5)
after a release the layer's controller holds last = now, a target L* in [cap - target_band, cap] and due = last + gap
with one group fewer on the layer the next release comes earlier (the due tick only moves forward); with the clock off there is no adaptive due tick
at the cap the clock pauses: no due tick, and the layer's status row says 'paused at the cap'
an unflagged cavern native is adopted as a native group (depth 0-2) and counted against its cavern's cap
a cavern at its cap holds its natural cavern-only species at raw frequency 1 (never 0), listed in CACHE.capHeld; below the cap they go back to the snapshot; hold off holds nothing
a cavern over its cap sends off its oldest native group (members' leave countdown <= 10, originals in g.trim_undo); the disable path puts the countdowns back
no deep unit in any group record, no deep-entry species held or capped, and `groups adopt` refuses a deep unit (R60)
each water body's cap follows the formula, the water ceiling defaults to 0 (none) and the `water` status quotes groups per water body, not a fixed 2 (R45)
a group's leader is its largest adult male; a group with no adult male has no leader and says unled (no fallback, R32)
a leader that died or left is not replaced: leader_lost names why, nobody follows anybody, a panic ledger line; after panic_days the end line and the group stays unled
during a panic the members within panic_tiles are walked away (path.goal SeekStation with a non-empty path)
a group drawn into water (Driver B) is led in the same pass by a leader standing in water (flow >= 4), members following at follow_school / follow_pod
`place TOKEN 6` places one clustered group, tracked as one record and led at once
a school DF seeded in surface water is a record with seeded=true, led but never counted (ENGINE.count('water'))
no sponge or IMMOBILE creature is ever a group's leader (cohesion label solitary)
`groups adopt a b c` makes exactly those units one record, removed from any other, led by R32's rule; a citizen is refused
a cavern animal-people species' cluster range is held at <= apcap (5); an irruption on its cavern lifts it; the disable path restores the raw
all off and disable put back the cavern gate's frequency holds and the animal-people cluster ranges
the apex scheduler has one job caller, tick() -> ROSTER.placeTick; the guarded ROSTER.apex.tick hook is gone (replaces mech.v71.apex.hook)
v7.gate_drain (on by default) releases the next-oldest gated groups of the layer until at most one flagged animal remains
the irruption config is rev 2 with every key of the notes' table; a v7.0 config migrates (gain -> src.citizens, migrated 'v7.0'); out-of-range and wrong-type values are dropped
a v7.0 armed group is stood down at the first pass (agitated flags cleared, g.armed gone, its cavern cooling down); the old global cooldown spreads to idle caverns and is removed

a cavern pinned at the threshold warns within one pass (ledger 'something stirs') and irrupts with a wave when the warning ends; no civ race with fallback none gives no warning, one ledger line and a daily retry
an event is per cavern: the others stay idle, activeOn names only that cavern, and only its gate gap halves
a wave is clamp(cluster max x size_mult, size_min, size_cap) units bounded by stock and unit_cap, one irruption-marked group record, led, the entry debited by n
a civ wave: each enabled token on the champion plus max(1, round(pct n / 100)) others, exactly one unit with every token, each write read back on the unit
after placement every caste of the race reads its original CURIOUS*, MEANDERER, AMBUSHPREDATOR, prone_to_rage and HAS_ANY_CURIOUS_BEAST; no caste write is held
during an event only that cavern's non-civ natural animals are agitated (up to the cap): never civ dwellers, citizens, tame animals, other caverns, the deep or non-natural units
an event ends (by the player, by its duration) with every write undone: masks, caste cache, hidden, mood, skill, agitation; countdowns by end_mode; cooldown set; pressure 0; group marks cleared
`irruption off`, disable, groups off and all off each end a running event with no residual write and no active phase; while off nothing is placed or written
irruption candidates are natural only, agitation never reaches a non-natural unit, and nothing is placed or agitated below the third cavern (R60)
each phase announces once (warn, start, wave, finish, ready, lapse); pause.start pauses the game; with every msg off nothing is announced
`irruption status` prints the purpose line, every config row and one row per cavern; `status` prints the one-liner
during an event on a cavern with an animal-people species its cluster range is the raw's own (cap lifted); after the end it is capped again
the Panel/Layers rows for IRRUPT v2 (irruption.md section 9) read and write the same keys

`roster build land` runs the guild-first builder: slot lines with their members, an UNFILLED line (with a reason) for every slot under its minimum, the FREQUENCY ladder, the vegetation survey line; a water build carries the column-depth (deep-water) survey

`roster outgun land` lists the outgunned pack-vs-herd pairs (factor >= v7 outgun) read-only (the config version does not move); with v7 outgun_cap on, a build caps each outgunned prey's group size at pred mass x factor / prey mass

the realm table holds every curated species plus the extinct rows over the REALM_ORDER codes (250 in v7.1; '300+' was never the table's size); with v7 realms on, V7.realmOk refuses a species whose realms exclude the embark's and admits its own realm and any unlisted species; with realms off it admits all

after `roster build land` the ladder-info line's carn_units is within 0.03 of carn (R59 unit shares), every ladder value is >= 1, and no apex reads a FREQUENCY above apex_raw_cap unless apex_odds > 0 (R34)
`roster apex now land` places one apex group from stock: ids > 0, the key's entries debited by the group size, and g.groups holds a placed=true tag='apex' record
with an apex group on the map and the cap at 1, the scheduler's decision is 'cap 1 reached' (ROSTER.apex.decide, not forced)
`roster build flying` seats at most one RP (R50) and fills the APX slot with no vulture, buzzard, kea or raven
on an ocean fort `roster build water` fills APE and PE or reports them UNFILLED ('no candidate in pool'); FISH_LAMPREY_SEA slots as MW (R49)
V7.isCivRaw is true for ANT_MAN and BAT_MAN, false for WOLF_MAN (R61); every pool entry carries a civ boolean
classify(DAMSELFLY_MAN).mass >= 30,000 cm3 and its guild is RP (R25: a vermin-root animal person is a small predator of its own size)
with the tool applied, every in-embark animal person at raw FREQUENCY 0 reads >= 1 (roster.ap_freq_floor); after restore the raws read 0 again (R61)
`place MAGMA_CRAB 1 deep` is refused (the deep is never touched, R28/R60) and creates no unit
on a calm map, Add invasive of CENOZOIC_SMILODON (SAVAGE) places >= 1 unit at once and `roster apex` lists it as a tool-placed invasive (R36)
`realm table` prints a realm-table head with missing_from_raws=0 on vanilla raws and one realm-entry line per entry (250 in v7.1)
`roster gobble land` prints >= 1 kind=write edge, and every kind=native edge names a class the consumer's own GOBBLE_VERMIN_CLASS and the vermin's creature classes share (R51)
200 creature raws carry REAL_WORLD_EXTINCT on vanilla and every TAGS token in the raws carries it; `extinct list` shows no 'no REAL_WORLD_EXTINCT class' row
applied with the fix on: T. rex FREQUENCY 2, Quetzalcoatlus 5, Titanoboa 3, Mosasaurus still 50 (no row); after restore 50 / 100 / 30 / 50
applied: TRICERATOPS every caste GRAZER, misc.grazer 150, HAS_ANY_GRAZER, guild GZ; after restore the vanilla values (no GRAZER, misc.grazer -1, no HAS_ANY_GRAZER); CENOZOIC_MOA's GRAZER untouched

applied: EORAPTOR BENIGN off, CARNIVORE on, guild ML, role predator; TIKTAALIK LARGE_PREDATOR off, guild MW; TITANOBOA LARGE_PREDATOR on, guild AW; DIMETRODON habitat land, guild AL, on the land roster part
`extinct off` -> classify(TRICERATOPS).guild is PL and EORAPTOR is prey; the raws read vanilla
a write/restore round trip leaves every TAGS raw (frequency, grazer, benign, large predator, carnivore, ambush, cluster) as it was before the write
a T. rex held by CAVERN (raw 1) is corrected in the snapshot (2), not the raw; both restore orders end at raw 50
a T. rex FREQUENCY written by hand (7) is left alone by the fix (stand_down) and its row reads 'stood down (raw 7)'
with fix and realms on, the realm table gains the fossil-locality rows (CRETACEOUS_TYRANNOSAURUS NEA); with `extinct set realms off` they are gone; a user-json entry survives both
a wild extinct animal on the map takes the corrected caste flags into its own cache on apply and gets its own back on restore; a tame one is untouched
on the vanilla rig `extinct mods` prints 'attack mods active: 0' and names the five mod-only animal people
on an embark with an extinct land apex, a land build reads its FREQUENCY as 'raw 2'/'raw 3' (the corrected raw), not a cap of a 50

with v7 gobble on, an apply tags every in-embark vermin species' castes with its SWV_* class and writes GOBBLE_VERMIN_CLASS onto the matched consumers (GOBBLE_RULES and the edge table); `vermin classes` reports it
VRM-SWV-SPLIT: `vermin classes` lists SWV_COLONY (bees, termites) and SWV_BAT (bats); SWV_SOIL holds no VERMIN_SOIL_COLONY species

VRM-EDGES-SRC: `vermin edges` names the source in force and the edge table; under source edges and source rules every in-embark consumer's castes carry exactly the SWV classes VERMIN.gobbleWants gives it (per-species rows after a roster build)
VRM-CLASS-OFF: `vermin class SWV_HERP off` leaves no vermin caste tagged SWV_HERP and no consumer gobbling it; `on` puts both back
VRM-RESTORE-v71: V7.restore (disable, all off) removes every SWV_* string from creature_class and the gobble vectors, the new SWV_COLONY and SWV_BAT included
VRM-VECTOR: `vermin census` reads a vermin vector (not NO VERMIN VECTOR) holding objects; colony sites are counted apart from loose vermin and their amount is not in the loose amount

VRM-FORAGE-RUN: `vermin forage now` returns a number and the status shows a last pass with its source; every pending forager is wild, not tame, natural, not deep, and walks to the recorded destination
VRM-FORAGE-OFF: `vermin forage off` empties pending, cancels the job (PANEL.jobs shows it off) and clears the released units' walks
VRM-CFG: a saved vermin_eat with out-of-range numbers and a bad source loads as the defaults; a class key it lacks loads as on
VRM-PERF: the vermin foraging job's worst pass stays under 50 ms over 3,000 ticks with the tool on

on a fort with deep ocean columns `water depth` shows ocean columns at 3 and 4 stacked water tiles, ENGINE.deepColumns finds n > 0, the scan reads below the top water level (zReached) and is not stopped
on OCEAN2 the ocean's column-depth histogram holds only 1 and 2 (max 2), nothing at 3 or more
a stride-1 water survey (`water depth full`) counts about 4x the stride-2 columns in every well-filled column-depth bucket (within 10%)
a saved water.deep_levels carries over as water.column_levels (an explicit column_levels wins; default 3), and `water levels 2` changes ENGINE.deepColumns().need to 2
the ocean's Driver B candidates include AQUATIC species listed on land-layer entries (keys with no water: prefix), no species twice; `water aquatic off` removes them
`water mix BODY` prints each candidate's base x factor = weight with its reasons; the species most present in the body gets a balance factor under 1; the weights sum above 0

with a body already holding water.mix.apex_max (1) curated-apex groups every apex candidate there weighs 0 (a non-apex keeps its weight; with none held the apex weighs > 0); FISH_LAMPREY_SEA is level C, not an apex (R49)

with prey drawn into the ocean, a predator or listed apex that takes it shows a pull factor >= water.pull.min in its weight, and a pelagic predator over pelagic_ref with prey here has the shallow floor lifted (its base equals its raw FREQUENCY)

a predator drawn while its prey swims is seeded by its prey (ledger 'seeded by its prey'): every member on a water tile (level >= 4/7), within seek_radius of a prey unit, on a column as deep as the deepest sampled there (less one)
on r2 the water status says breathing is read via getBreathingState, and a drawn fish teleported onto dry land is moved back to open water within two guard passes (ledger strand ... moved)
a body with nothing drawable backs off water.retry_days (1 day = 1,200 ticks), not the old 5-day gap: next_water_body[body] - now <= retry_days x 1200
no BEAR_* (a fisher on the curated list) is ever a Driver B water candidate
the water census and the Driver B candidates never include a cavern or deep-layer entry or a unit outside the surface band (R60)
after a groups pass FUSE.stats['seasonal-wildlife/groups'].kb is a number >= 0 and the worst tick (CACHE.perfTickWorst.ms) is at least that job's worst pass
`perf` prints the switch line, the job table and either DFHack perf-counter rows or the 'not in this DFHack build' line, with no error
V7.PERF.raceEco(CACHE.cfg, race) equals ecoOf(cfg, raw) for every race on the map; CACHE.ecoClass is filled after an ecology pass; `perf legacy class on` gives the same V7.natural answers
loadGroups() returns the same shared table twice; after saveGroups the compact site-data record decodes to the same number of groups and carries no 'stuck' key (persist_transient off)
UNDO.push raises UNDO.depth() by one on the held ring (CACHE.undo, the same table before and after) and UNDO.pop takes it back
V7.PERF.overlayData() twice within a second returns the same table, holding one marker per group with a live member
inside a pass, WILD.countByLayer() from the census equals the v7.0 loop over units.active, and discoverGroups finds the same unit ids with `perf legacy census on`
after enable every job the Panel lists as on is scheduled at once, and over a short run no tick is shared by two jobs unless a deferral (FUSE.DEFER) fired
the Live tab's biomass sum per layer from the managed-entry index (P6) equals the v7.0 walk over every population (legacy_live), computed headless the way the window does
a groups pass with no config writer due leaves CACHE.cfg the same table and CACHE.ver unchanged (one due saves and replaces it); CAVERN.apply run twice in a row saves its snapshot at most once
V7.PERF.pool(CACHE.cfg) twice returns the same pool with the memo's hits +1; a saveConfig makes the next call rebuild it

the edge-only CAVE and WET surveys count exactly what the legacy full scan counts; on r2 the forEachTile vegetation grass share is within 3 points of the Lua scan and PLACE.tiles starts on the same level

after enable the load-time warm slice has run (CACHE.sliceLog.warm, n >= 1, no error) and the cave, wet-edge, water and vegetation surveys are cached; `perf build land` finishes its slice without error
`perf census` walks the wild-id set; the set holds every live wild unit on the map, including any that arrived during the run (event or tail scan)
the edible natural remains a scavenging pass finds are the same with `perf legacy scav on` and off, and V7.PERF.webCensus(g).wild equals WILD.countByLayer()
GET /controls.json answers 200 with at least 12 sections and 300 controls, and every available control (no {T}) carries its current value
POST /set?id=hunters.stoop.chance&v=61 answers 200 with value 61, the config reads 61 and the ledger gains a line; v=101 answers 400 'at most 100'; an unknown id answers 400
POST /set?id=switch.nudge&v=on sets ecology.nudge through the Panel's own path (one undo step) and v=off puts it back
GET /status.json returns every status section with no error, and the group map's first layer key is 'land'
the snapshot's group sizes follow the raws: for a species with two cluster numbers gmin < gmax and gmax == cluster_number[0] (the web-cluster-order fix)
the v7.1 endpoints refuse what they should: /act roster_build with an argument off its list 400, /set by GET 405, /set or /controls.json without the token 403, /cmd 'groups adopt' 400
after the first, every snapshot the server builds takes under 50 ms (static species fields cached per world)
`seasonal-wildlife-web stop` after the v7.1 checks closes the port
